content.title: You+Me - Against the World
content.overview: Alma Lancaster, 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi, 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love — despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.
content.tagline: He runs from everything. Except her.

Title: You+Me - Against the World

Original Title: Toi+Moi - Seuls contre tous

Tagline: He runs from everything. Except her.

Overview: Alma Lancaster, 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi, 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love — despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.

Genres: Romance, Drama

Production Companies: Amazon Studios France, Originals by Trésor, Trésor Films, Amazon MGM Studios

Production Countries: France, United States of America

Spoken Languages: French
